nodes.label: Achieve Profitable European Market Entry Within Budget

coaching.summary: Your European expansion decision hinges on the trade-off between European Revenue Generated and market reach through Local Sales Team Presence versus the compounding risks of Budget Overrun Risk and GDPR Compliance Failure. The GDPR Compliance Investment is the most decisive swing factor: under-investing triggers compliance failure, but over-investing crowds out Go-to-Market Budget Allocated within the $2M cap.

strengthen_items.label: Pilot market before full launch
strengthen_items.detail: A single-country pilot (e.g. Germany or Netherlands) would test Product-Market Cultural Fit and compliance costs before committing the full budget.

strengthen_items.label: Currency hedging constraint
strengthen_items.detail: EUR/USD Currency Exposure is unhedged in this model; a hedging policy or EUR-denominated pricing could materially reduce revenue volatility.

elements_considered_but_excluded: Single-country pilot option: structurally similar to remote GTM without a distinct enough intervention profile to add as a separate option; surfaced in coaching instead
Headcount ramp risk: subsumed into budget overrun and local sales indicator uncertainty drivers

bias_signals.detail: The brief frames the decision as a three-way channel choice without considering a staged or pilot entry that could reduce irreversible commitment under budget constraint.
